text:
maria: Quick check-in — I'm about to land the ExternalSecret + Terraform changes for the service secret rotation gating. Wanted to surface the plan and get a quick review before I apply in staging.
maria: TL;DR: adding a new annotation to ExternalSecrets to opt-in to rotation-gating, a small IAM change for the vault read role, and a helm value to enable graceful fallback while rotation runs. Rollout will be canary'd on staging then prod.
maria: Proposed Terraform snippet (killed down for Slack):
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "es_service_secret" {
  manifest = yamldecode(templatefile("externalsecret.yml.tpl", {
    name = "service-x-secret",
    vault_path = "secret/data/services/service-x",
    annotations = {
      "redwood.com/rotation-gate" = "enabled"
    }
  }))
}

# iam binding to allow vault read via extsvc agent
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "extsecret_vault_read" {
  role = aws_iam_role.extsecret_agent.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.vault_read.json
}
```
maria: And snippet for the ExternalSecret template we plan to use:
```
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: service-x-secret
  annotations:
    redwood.com/rotation-gate: "enabled"
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1m"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-store
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: service-x
    creationPolicy: Owner
  data:
  - secretKey: api_key
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/services/service-x
      property: api_key
```
akshay: quick Q — is the annotation checked by a controller or by our rollout job? i.e., how do we avoid a non-gated ExternalSecret pulling a rotated value mid-deploy?
olivia: The plan is: controller still syncs keys, but rotation-gate triggers a pre-rollout hook that pauses automatic refresh for that target and flips in a migrated copy once the canary verifies. The gate is mostly a signal to the rollout automation.
ryan: Important: please ensure refreshInterval stays short in staging so we get visible behavior. Also add a finalizer to avoid deletion races with rotation jobs.
maria: good call — I'll add a `finalizers` entry in the manifest and set `refreshInterval: 30s` in staging only via helm values.
sam: I left comments on the TF PR — specifically around the IAM policy scope. We should scope to the path `secret/data/services/service-x` not the whole services/ prefix. otherwise blast radius increases. :eyes:
maria: agreed, tightening IAM. I'll update the PR.
akshay: Another thing — rotation metrics. Can we emit a gauge counter when a rotation-gate is hit and when fallback occurs? Want to make sure SRE can track number of revolutions.
olivia: yes, there's a small exporter in the rotation job that emits `rotation_gate_events{service="service-x",outcome="success|fallback"}`. We'll wire that into the console dashboard.
ryan: One nit: the helm value name `rotation.gate.enabled` is a bit vague. Maybe `secrets.rotation.gate.enabled` to keep it namespaced.
maria: done, will rename and add to values.schema.json so linting catches mistakes.
deploy-bot: [deploy] staging apply queued by maria — plan posted to PR #842. :rocket:
maria: I'm going to patch the TF IAM narrowing and the finalizer change, then run `terraform apply` in staging. Asking @akshay @olivia @ryan for a quick thumbs when the PR is green — plan to roll the canary to two pods first.
akshay: :+1: will watch the PR.
olivia: :thumbsup: agree with two-pod canary.
sam: left an additional comment around the secret TTL. We should ensure rotation TTL in Vault policy matches the expected in-app TTL — otherwise we could end up with decrypted stale tokens.
maria: noted — I'll sync the Vault TTL to 24h for service-x and add that to the PR description.
ryan: If any of the canary fails, auto-fallback should swap to the last-known-good secret. Make sure the fallback path is tested in staging before prod.
maria: plan: manual verify fallback in staging by triggering a simulated rotation, then trigger canary. If all good, schedule prod after maintenance window. I'll follow up with a short runbook in the PR.
maria: thanks everyone, will update when staging apply finishes.
deploy-bot: [status] staging apply finished: plan OK, 2 resources to add, 1 to change. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/pr/842/plan
maria: OK PR merged and apply done in staging. Follow-up runbook in PR and dashboard panels linked. Leaving this thread open for any post-apply observations.
